(6 goals) | award = | prev_season = [[2024–25 King's Cup (Saudi Arabia)|2024–25]] | next_season = [[2026–27 King's Cup (Saudi Arabia)|2026–27]] }} The '''2025–26 King's Cup,''' or '''The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Cup,''' was the 38th edition of the [[King's Cup (Saudi Arabia)|King's Cup]] since its establishment in 1966, and the 19th edition since the tournament was relaunched in [[2008 King Cup of Champions|2008]]. The tournament began on 31 August 2025 and concluded with the final on 8 May 2026.{{cite web |title=الكشف عن مواعيد أدوار كأس الملك 2025-2026.. تعرف عليها |url=https://sabq.org/sports/8fxhd8w4bf}} The winner qualifies to the group stage of the [[2026–27 AFC Champions League Two]].{{Cite news |title=SAFF approves mechanism for participation of Saudi clubs in AFC competitions |url=https://www.saudigazette.com.sa/article/636064 |website=saudi gazette}} [[Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah)|Al-Ittihad]] were the defending champions after winning their sixth title [[2024–25 King's Cup (Saudi Arabia)|last season]].{{cite web |title=الكأس الملكية... «اتحادية»
